items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I think maybe Ray Charles was even in it.

ctx.x: Any other characters that have stuck out in your — I see something about Woody Herman. Well Dave Holland you mentioned. Peter Frampton, why would you cross paths with Peter Frampton?

He was — there was a rock concert in — I was trying to review that history, I asked Rod Fleeman about that when Dry Jack was living in Kansas City and there was a rock, multi- band rock show. And we were — Dry Jack was one of the — for some reason I guess ‘cause we were local, but this was a heavy duty — I can remember the other — I think maybe Ray Charles was even in it. But there was a jam session and I was invited out, Rod and I were invited out to play with him. So that was the — looks good on the resume.

Yeah. If you got a commission to write a new original piece how would you start? Now let’s suppose it’s a pretty open-ended thing. It could be a solo piano composition or maybe it could turn into a group thing from there. But is there a way you approach the piano differently if you know I need to write something, I need to write something that is playable by me but other people also, as opposed to just like what you did a couple of times today already, just your hands start going.
